newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus plans new rules for public share bids.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus plans new rules for public share bids.

text.p: Cyprus plans legislation to guarantee equal treatment for all shareholders in bid situations, the Cyprus News Agency reported Finance Minister Christodoulos Christodolou as saying on Friday.

All public bids must ensure equal treatment of shareholders and provide them with adequate time and information to make a decision. The results of public bids must be announced through specific procedures.
The planned amendments to 1993 stock exchange legislation would set penalties of up to two years in prison and fines of up to 5,000 pounds ($10,000). ($=0.50 Cyprus pound)
